guards.what: EV-2: ClimbOption's 13 Max HP loss (DrowningBeacon.cs:53) calls RunState.lose_max_hp (run.py:316-321), which floors max HP and CLAMPS current HP. C#'s CreatureCmd.LoseMaxHp (CreatureCmd.cs) damages the overflow through the damage pipeline (Unblockable|Unpowered) FIRST, against the UNFLOORED new max, and only then calls SetMaxHp(Math.Max(1m, newMaxHp))
guards.maps_to: Closed 2026-07-28: RunState.lose_max_hp (run.py:366-380) now has the shape of CreatureCmd.LoseMaxHp (CreatureCmd.cs:811-828) -- `new_max = max_hp - amount` UNFLOORED, then `if new_max < hp: lose_hp(hp - new_max)` so the overflow is real HP loss that runs the relic ModifyHpLost pass and the death pass, and only then `max_hp = max(1, new_max)` followed by SetMaxHpInternal's clamp `hp = min(hp, max_hp)` (Creature.cs:493-501). Leg (2) now MATCHes: 80/80 losing 100 max HP kills the player on both sides (`py audit/tools/event_probes.py maxhp`). Leg (1)'s witness does not survive re-reading the source: the probe's hardcoded `C#=71` ignores SetMaxHpInternal's `CurrentHp = Math.Min(CurrentHp, MaxHp)`, which pulls the GAME back to 70 as well, so Tungsten Rod's -1 is unobservable through HP at any max-HP-loss amount (the overflow can never leave current HP above the new max). Both sides read on 2026-07-28; the sim's 70/70 is correct.
